podcast.body: This fifth album was released after a four-year break, during a period (2012-2013) when rock bands were struggling to make waves amidst the dominance of indie rock, characterized by bands like Mumford & Sons. The band expressed initial uncertainty about how the record would be received by Canadian rock stations. Its themes touch upon global political and social realities like Brexit, the refugee crisis, the rise of the right, and Donald Trump. The band views it not as a "political record" but a reflection of current global realities affecting people they know. Drummer Aaron was unable to perform on this album due to an MS relapse, with Jordan Hastings filling in.
